trajectory.name: Bash

input.command:
cat > /tmp/clockchain_timer.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Set timer for 5 seconds (5000 ms)
TIMER_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:9000/timer/set" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "delay_ms": 5000,
    "label": "eval-06934971"
  }')

echo "Timer set response: $TIMER_RESPONSE"
TIMER_ID=$(echo "$TIMER_RESPONSE" | jq -r '.id // empty')

if [ -z "$TIMER_ID" ]; then
  echo "Failed to get timer ID"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Timer ID: $TIMER_ID"

# Poll status until done
while true; do
  STATUS=$(curl -s -X GET "http://localhost:9000/timer/status/$TIMER_ID" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json")
  
  echo "Status check: $STATUS"
  
  STATE=$(echo "$STATUS" | jq -r '.state // empty')
  
  if [ "$STATE" = "done" ]; then
    echo "Timer fired!"
    echo "Full response: $STATUS"
    break
  fi
  
  sleep 1
done
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/clockchain_timer.sh
/tmp/clockchain_timer.sh
